Messages.Author: beslin igor
Messages.Body:
Gather
+1 stealth action. Unique.

Put this card in play, locked, and choose a younger Gangrel in your uncontrolled region. During the influence phase, you may lock this card to move that Gangrel from your uncontrolled region to your ready region, with any counters he or she has, unless that Gangrel would contest a vampire in play. Any vampire can burn this card as a Ⓓ action that costs 1 pool.

If I understand good when Gangrel with Gather enters in play him enter with Gather on him. and any vampire can burn Gather. what happen with vampire who is in play with Gather if is Gather burned?

Messages.Author: Yomyael
Messages.Body:
Nothing. It would require additional text if anything were to happen, when Gather leaves play.

Prince of Bonn, Germany

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Yomyael wrote:
> Nothing. It would require additional text if anything were to happen, when Gather leaves play.
>
Correct.
Also, please note that the card is unique so its controller may need to burn it in order to play another one.
